Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bikes, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences, and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



Welcome to "La Dolce Beacha" a spacious brand new gorgeously furnished beach home located in Inlet Beach. This luxury vacation home is located only minutes from 30A and situated just steps to the neighborhood's private beach access. This beach home is perfect for a large family, or even a couples retreat, complete with sleeping arrangements for up to 8, 2 indoor family rooms, and an outdoor patio space with views for days. If you get tired of the amazing views from the King Suite located on the 2nd floor of the home you can head up to the spacious balcony where you can view the Gulf and gorgeous white sand dunes for days. You'll also be able to enjoy watching the game, or a late-night family movie on the 70" tv mounted outside on the upper deck. You are less than a 1 minute's walk to the private community beach access, where you will enjoy spending the day on the white sandy beaches of the Emerald Coast! As if the home, views, and close beach proximity weren't enough, you will also be able to relax the day away poolside, at the community pool which is right across the street from the home! This home is located very close to 30 Avenue and is only a short bike ride away from many of the great shops and restaurants that 30A, has to offer!



The 1st FLOOR: Main living area, kitchen, dining area (seating for 9), half bathroom.



The 2nd FLOOR: Queen Suite with Tub/shower combo, King suite with Walk-in shower. Stackable Washer and Dryer.



The 3rd FLOOR: Second family room with panoramic views, Queen bedroom, bedroom with 2 twin beds. Full bathroom in the hallway with tub/shower combo.



The 4th FLOOR: Massive Balcony with a mounted 70" flat screen tv and views for days!



Each room has a TV - Complimentary WIFI / Internet Access



AMENITIES:



- Gas Grill

- Amazing Gulf Views

- Only minutes to 30A

- 1 King Suite

- 2 Queen Bedrooms

-Open Concept Family room / Kitchen/ Dining

- Cable TV in Every Room!

- High-Speed Internet / WIFI

- 3 Minutes to Private Beach Access

- Community Pool

- Granite Kitchen Counter Tops

- Stainless Kitchen Appliances

- Ceiling Fans Throughout

- Flat Screen TVs in all Bedrooms- Linens and Bath Towels Provided

- Washer / Dryer



-Designated parking for MAX 2 vehicles in driveway, no street parking.

Make "La Dolce Beacha" your next family vacation, and we are confident it will become an annual family vacation destination for years to come!



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



FAQ:



Type of coffee pot: K cup or standard coffee pot



Parking spots: MAX 2 vehicles in the driveway, No street parking.



Distance to beach: 3-minute walk



Bikes included: no (can use rental credit towards bikes.)



Beach Chairs & Umbrella set-up included: NO ( can use rental credit toward beach chair set-up)



Community Pool heated: no



**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located by the ocean, this vacation home is in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with cycling.
